Someone with gateway admin access will need to configure gateway auth or pair this device. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll set up the Monday 08:00 (Chicago time) digest for #coastal-team, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random. In the meantime, I can post a digest by hand if that helps.

The digest will leave out finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms) and anything from direct messages, since neither belongs in a shared channel.
